---
title: RL with AReaL
---

The AReaL integration uses SearcherKit for agent conversation, tool execution,
limits, errors, and trajectory metadata. AReaL owns distributed scheduling,
rollout generation, optimization, checkpoints, and experiment tracking.

## Prerequisites

Install AReaL according to [its manual](https://areal-ai.io/en/tutorial/installation.html), then install SearcherKit
into that environment. Every participating node must be able to access the
model, tokenizer, dataset, name-resolution storage, output paths, and retrieval
services referenced by the config.

The main entry points are:

| Algorithm | Python entry point | Example Script |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GRPO | `searcherkit.training.areal.train_dist` | `scripts/areal/train_dist_areal.sh` |
| IGPO | `searcherkit.training.areal.train_igpo` | `scripts/areal/train_dist_areal_igpo.sh` |

## Configure the rollout agent

Start with `src/searcherkit/config/training/train_areal.yaml` for GRPO or
`train_dist_areal_igpo.yaml` for IGPO. 

Configure `workflow.agent` and `eval_workflow.agent` to define agents. For other configurations, check [AReaL Manual](https://areal-ai.io/en/cli_reference.html)

## Run training

The launch scripts contain cluster-specific defaults. Override hardware related configuration, paths, and experiment name.

```bash
bash scripts/areal/train_dist_areal.sh \
    cluster.n_nodes=2 \
    actor.backend=fsdp:d4c2 \
    rollout.backend=sglang:d8 \
    rollout.max_concurrent_rollouts=256 \
    actor.path=Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
    trial_name=experiment_name \
    train_dataset.path=/path/to/dataset \
```

## IGPO

IGPO recipe contains SearcherKit's reproduction of the [IGPO reward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.14967). Run with the `searcherkit.training.areal.train_igpo` entry point or start from the `train_dist_areal_igpo.sh`

```bash
bash scripts/areal/train_dist_areal_igpo.sh \
  actor.path=/models/Qwen3-8B \
  ...
```

## Failure and reward accounting

During the training, retrying should only be carried for external, recoverable error like tool invoking timeouts. Handle model related errors like `LLMError` and return a low score to allow RL engine to punish such action.

Uncaught error, like exhausted retries and fatal errors would cause the rollout trajectory to be discarded. If such problem should be processed, caught the exception within workflow.

Monitor rollout completion, exception categories, outcome and format scores,
overlength and truncation penalties, tool calls, repeated queries, context
tokens, KL, clipping, entropy, loss, and gradient norm.
